title: LM-DSB: A Lightweight Multi-agent System for Automated Daily Safety Bulletin Generation in Construction
abstract: arXiv:2610.36433v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Construction safety management still struggles to produce daily safety bulletins (DSBs), structured daily communications that identify site-specific hazards, convey safety protocols, and set preventive measures for workers. Manual DSB creation takes 2-3 hours daily and yields inconsistent quality, with 25% of crews never conducting pretask planning (Olson et al., 2016), diverting safety personnel from field supervision. This study proposes the Lightweight Multi-Agent DSB System (LM-DSB), which integrates retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) with a locally deployable Large Language Model (LLM) to automate DSB generation on consumer-grade personal computers. LM-DSB coordinates specialized planner, researcher, and writer agents in a hierarchical architecture, enhanced by domain-specific fine-tuning on construction safety documentation and RAG grounding in 37 health, safety, and environment (HSE) documents. translated_title: LM-DSB：一种用于建筑行业每日安全公告自动化生成的轻量级多智能体系统
translated_abstract: 建筑安全管理至今仍难以高效产出每日安全公告（DSB），这是一种结构化的日常沟通文件，用于识别现场特定危险、传达安全规程并为工人制定预防措施。手动编写DSB每天需耗时2-3小时且质量参差不齐，25%的施工班组从未开展任务前安全规划（Olson等人，2016），导致安全人员无暇专注于现场监督。本研究提出了轻量级多智能体DSB系统（LM-DSB），将检索增强生成（RAG）与可本地部署的大语言模型（LLM）相结合，实现在消费级个人电脑上自动生成DSB。LM-DSB采用分层架构协调规划者、研究者和写作者三个专业智能体，并通过在建筑安全文档上的领域特定微调，以及基于37份健康、安全与环境（HSE）文档的RAG检索增强来提升系统性能。一项两阶段验证评估了该系统的可
tldr: 该研究提出LM-DSB系统，通过多智能体分层协作架构结合RAG与本地部署的大语言模型，在消费级个人电脑上自动生成建筑每日安全公告，解决了人工编写耗时长、质量不稳定的问题。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes LM-DSB, a lightweight multi-agent system that integrates RAG with a locally deployable LLM to automate construction daily safety bulletin generation on consumer-grade PCs, addressing the time-consuming and inconsistent manual writing process.
